title: Pitch Pot
tagline: Pull back, pitch the arrow, and drop it in the bronze vase.
description: The old Chinese and Korean throwing game of touhu and tuho. Pull back to aim and pitch bamboo arrows into a narrow-necked bronze vase: score the mouth, the bounce-ins and the ears. Real arrow physics, four computer opponents, two players, practice, Think and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Press anywhere and slide to pull the arrow back.
Lift your thumb to throw; the dotted path shows the plan.
Mouth 2, bounce-in 3, ear 5, all four in the pot +3.
Arrows left in the vase change later throws.
Tap Think for a tested suggestion.
